summary: Kroger Co. filed an 8-K announcing it has entered into a merger agreement to acquire Giant Eagle, Inc. for approximately $1.65 billion, consisting of $1.25 billion in cash and $400 million in assumed liabilities. The acquisition is expected to close in 2027, subject to HSR antitrust clearance and customary conditions. Kroger anticipates limited store divestitures to satisfy regulatory requirements. No board recommendation or advisor is named in the filing. Risk-arb watchers should monitor the antitrust review timeline and potential store sale process.
